description: This file defines API routes for user authentication and account management in a Node.js Express application, including login, registration, password reset, and OAuth integrations with Google and Facebook.

methods.name: POST /login
methods.description: Authenticates a user with email and password, returning a JWT token upon success.

methods.name: POST /register
methods.description: Registers a new user, optionally subscribes them to a newsletter, and sends a welcome email.

methods.name: POST /forgot
methods.description: Generates a password reset token and emails it to the user.

methods.name: POST /reset/:token
methods.description: Resets the user's password using a valid reset token.

methods.name: POST /reset
methods.description: Allows an authenticated user to change their password.

methods.name: GET /google/callback
methods.description: Handles Google OAuth callback, issues JWT, and redirects to client.

methods.name: GET /facebook/callback
methods.description: Handles Facebook OAuth callback, issues JWT, and redirects to client.
